mapper.insert: INSERT INTO object_deletion_queue (workspace_id, object_key, attempts, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{objectKey}, 1, #{nextAttemptAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempts = LEAST(object_deletion_queue.attempts + 1, 2147483647), next_attempt_at = LEAST(object_deletion_queue.next_attempt_at, VALUES(next_attempt_at))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM object_deletion_queue WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM object_deletion_queue WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
